history.content: Can I carry firearms in the Town of Danville and how do I get a firearms permit?
In the Town of Danville, you can apply for a firearms permit through the Contra Costa Sheriff. However, I do not have information about if you can carry firearms in the Town of Danville.
does Town of Danville provide police report and background check letters?

Yes, town of Danville can provide police report. The police report may be obtained through the Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff Records Unit. You can contact the Dublin Police Services Business Office (6361 Clark Ave Dublin, CA 94568) or via the business number: (925) 833-6670. On the other hand, background check letter is not provided.  The letter is issued by the Records Department located at Martinez, CA. You can also request background check letter via email to Records Info as well.
